instruction: Please help me configure VS Code to display the interface in "Korean" without using any extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible in the OSWorld environment. VS Code's architecture requires language pack extensions to enable non-English interface languages. Without extensions, switching to Korean is not possible.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - VS Code requires language pack extensions for non-English interface languages
